description: Deterministic fixture agent for AGENT.REDTEAM.ESCAL AC-3 and AC-H3: a well-behaved client that does the ordinary task and then files pending requests for one W3 command (report.finalize_fai@1) and one X1 command (egress.send@1) by invoking their request-only MCP tools. The bus records each as a W1 request.file_request@1 entry and runs neither command. It runs the same calls on every task of suite/redteam/escal. Calls are MCP tool calls in order; the harness format for scripted agents is not yet defined (AGENT.HARNESS.RUN), so this file is declarative.
